recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a whisper about a bug is enough to crack the lock
robotic fingers learning to type by touch alone
twenty-seven billion parameters humming on a desktop
a barrier lake holding its breath above the valley
summer fog rolling in over the bay at seventeen degrees
agents waking from a phone shortcut before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Pilot a courier drone through layered SF summer fog — swipe between altitude lanes to collect scattered signal fragments before visibility drops to zero.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe up/down to change altitude lane
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each run assembles one line of a sunrise shipping manifest
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens and lanes narrow until only one corridor remains
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor overcast blues and soft orange horizon glow

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap network nodes to propagate a harmless rumor — each whisper has a decay timer and mistimed taps wake patrolling watchdogs.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap nodes in rhythm before their glow fades
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a perfect chain lights the entire graph in one cascading pulse
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: watchdog patrol speed doubles and decay timers shrink each wave
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe nodes on deep black with pulse trails

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Guide five robotic fingertips across a touch keyboard — drag curved paths between glowing keys before they dim, spelling fragments of code.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to connect keys in sequence without lifting
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: completing a word triggers a satisfying mechanical clack chorus
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: keys scatter farther apart and fade faster as dexterity ramps
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: brass joints and worn leather on a dim workshop bench

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick stones to skim across a rising barrier lake — each perfect skip briefly lowers the waterline but missed flicks crack the dam wall.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick outward to launch stones at angle and power
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: skip chains spawn rainbow ripples that echo across the valley
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: water level rises continuously and stones grow heavier each round
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout mountain silhouettes with ink-wash ripples
